notes: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) site. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic search/cart/checkout/account exclusions) - direct fetch worked without any WAF/bot block, no proxy needed. Not a duplicate-company case (not flagged in BRIEF, no prior monoprix.fr S.N. exists in scratchpad). Maison (Home) is one of several top-level departments (Mode/Beaute/Maison/Loisirs) on this general supermarket site alongside fashion, beauty, groceries etc - as expected, genuine decor scope is a narrow sub-tree, most of Maison is furniture (Mobilier), bedding/bath linens (Chambre/Salle de bain linens), small appliances (Petit electromenager), kitchenware/cutlery/disposables (Arts de la table et Cuisine sub-branches), laundry/cleaning (Buanderie et Menage), pet supplies (Chat et Chien), and gardening/beach (Exterieur) - all excluded per brief. Full Maison category tree enumerated via the rendered mega-menu (data-levels attributes) and cross-checked against sitemap_3-category.xml (164 /c/maison* URLs) to confirm no decor nodes were missed - none were. Counts verified via each category's own 'X produit(s) sur N' listing-header text (French thousands-separator fix not needed, all counts here are 2-3 digits). Rule 0 gains: Kids Lighting (Luminaires enfant, qty 1) kept in scope under Rule 0.1 despite living under a 'kids' room-context node; Bathroom Mirrors (qty 4) kept under Rule 0.3/0.4 as a second, genuinely distinct mirrors listing separate from the general Wall Decor > Mirrors node (different URL/category-ID, different product set, both real catalog nodes - documented per Rule 0.6, no evidence of product-ID overlap since they sit in unrelated site branches with independent counts of 7 vs 4). Cache-pots (planters) is a real but currently EMPTY node (0 products) - page renders a 'search-no-result-cross-sell' recommendation slot instead of a product grid, confirmed genuine empty listing rather than a fetch failure. Candles (Bougies, 86 total) is a heavily mixed scented/unscented roll-up with no scent facet on the site to isolate an exact count - inspected all ~85 unique product titles: ~42 explicitly say 'parfum(ee)' and most of the remainder also name a fragrance (Jasmin, Ambre, Santal, Vanille, Fleur d'Hibiscus, Fleurs de Monoi, etc, i.e. also scented), leaving a genuinely unscented subset (plain taper candles, egg/rabbit novelty candles, LED flameless candle, designer colour candles) whose exact boundary cannot be verified without per-SKU review - left qty null + flagged rather than estimate, per the one rule that matters. Excluded as a mixed roll-up per 'drop, don't pad': Vaisselle enfant (children's tableware, 30 total) mixes genuine kids plates/bowls/mugs with cutlery sets and insulated cooler bags with no way to isolate tableware-only via the site; Exterieur > Mobilier et decoration d'exterieur (despite the name, all 3 listed products are storage chests and a stool, no decor items); Jardinage > Pots (functional plastic garden pots, not decorative planters - distinct from the also-checked Cache-pots node); Objets decoratifs > Paniers, coffres et boites (storage baskets/toy chests, not decor accents). Kitchen Trays (Plateaux de cuisine, wood/ceramic serving trays, qty 18) included as a decorative accessory per brief's explicit 'trays' inclusion. Carafes/pitchers/teapots (38) and other Arts de la table nodes included as Kitchen & Dining tableware per brief; disposable tableware (Vaisselle jetable) and kitchen cutlery/cookware/storage nodes excluded per brief. No clocks category exists anywhere on the site (confirmed via sitemap + menu text search for horloge/pendule - zero hits).
